7.1.basis: Malaysia has a dedicated horizontal statute, the Personal Data Protection Act 2010, establishing a general framework for personal data protection (s.2(2) defines its scope), indicating a comprehensive rather than absent framework.

7.2.basis: Malaysia has a dedicated Cyber Security Act 2024, a standalone horizontal statute establishing a cybersecurity legal framework (s.4), supplemented by related provisions (licensing, critical infrastructure codes, reporting duties) throughout the Act. Since a comprehensive dedicated framework exists, the inverted indicator (lack of framework) scores 0, not 1 or 0.5.
